study_identification.author_journal_year: Coupé et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2022
study_identification.title: Hippocampal-amygdalo-ventricular atrophy score: Alzheimer disease detection using normative and pathological lifespan models

study_characteristics.study_objective: To develop and validate an MRI-based Hippocampal-Amygdalo-Ventricular Atrophy score (HAVAs) that combines normative (CN) and pathological (AD) lifespan models to detect AD and to prognose MCI progression.

dataset_name.reason: Training data comprise seven open-access datasets (C-MIND; NDAR; ABIDE; ICBM; IXI; OASIS; ADNI). External validation used AIBL and MIRIAD, with ADNI sMCI/pMCI for prognosis.
dataset_name.supporting_text: Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases (Table 1). … TABLE 2 External dataset used for validation (N = 1,039).

hc_n.reason: CN sample size for normative trajectories is N = 2,655 across 9 months to 94 years.
hc_n.supporting_text: This dataset was composed of 2,655 CN subjects (CN) and 377 patients with AD. For CN trajectories, we used the N = 2,655 subjects from 9 months to 94y of the training dataset.

hc_age.reason: Per-dataset mean and range are provided, but overall CN mean/SD are not reported. Overall CN age range spans approximately 0.74–94 years based on Table 1.
hc_age.supporting_text: Table 1 lists per-dataset age, e.g., C-MIND 8.44 (0.74–18.86); OASIS CN 45.34 (18–94); ADNI CN 74.81 (60–90).

hc_sex.reason: Sex counts are reported per CN dataset; aggregated across CN: F 1,226 (46.2%), M 1,429 (53.8%).
hc_sex.supporting_text: Table 1 provides gender per dataset, e.g., ABIDE CN F=84/M=408; IXI CN F=307/M=242; ADNI CN F=203/M=201, etc.

imaging_modality.supporting_text: Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases.

analysis_level.reason: ROI-level volumetry via AssemblyNet segmentation into 132 Neuromorphometrics structures, tissues, and lobes.
analysis_level.supporting_text: After preprocessing, the brain was segmented into several structures … Neuromorphometrics protocol … comprises 132 structures. These structures are combined to create tissue … and lobar segmentations.

preprocessing_pipeline.reason: AssemblyNet preprocessing pipeline: denoising; inhomogeneity correction; affine MNI registration; automatic QC (RegQCNet); second bias correction; intensity standardization; segmentation with 250 DL models using Neuromorphometrics protocol.
preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: All the considered images were processed using AssemblyNet … The AssemblyNet preprocessing pipeline was based on several steps: image denoising … inhomogeneity correction … affine registration to the MNI space, automatic quality control (QC) (RegQCNet) … intensity standardization … After preprocessing, the brain was segmented … using 250 DL models … Neuromorphometrics protocol (132 structures).

quality_checking.reason: Automatic QC via RegQCNet followed by expert visual assessment; failed cases removed from training dataset.
quality_checking.supporting_text: For all the training subjects detected as failure by the automatic QC RegQCNet … a visual assessment was performed … If the failure was confirmed … the subject was removed from training dataset.

quality_checking_detail.reason: QC procedure is described (automatic + visual) but the number/percentage of excluded subjects is not reported.
quality_checking_detail.supporting_text: … automatic QC RegQCNet … visual assessment … subject was removed …

site_effect_handling.reason: No explicit site/scanner effect modeling or batch harmonization (e.g., ComBat, HBR) is described; only standardized preprocessing and ICV/z-score normalization. Robustness assessed via external validation, but no site-effects removal in modeling.
site_effect_handling.supporting_text: Image processing and normalization steps are described; validation datasets are external (AIBL, MIRIAD), but no method for site/scanner batch effect handling is specified.

site_effect_handling_detail.reason: Details of any batch-effect removal or site/scanner modeling are not reported.

model_origin.reason: New models trained by the authors: CN and AD lifespan models estimated from the training datasets.
model_origin.supporting_text: To create our lifespan models, we estimated normal (CN) and pathological (AD) trajectories of structure volumes across the entire lifespan.

model_origin_detail.reason: Not pre-trained; models are newly estimated in this study.

modeling_method.reason: Polynomial lifespan modeling (linear/quadratic/cubic) for CN and AD trajectories per structure with model selection by ANOVA/T-tests and BIC; distances between trajectories used to quantify divergence.
modeling_method.supporting_text: To estimate the volume trajectories, we considered several low order polynomial models … candidate if ANOVA p<.05 and coefficients significant … select with BIC … estimate Euclidean distance between trajectories.

software_tool.reason: AssemblyNet used for preprocessing/segmentation; ClinicaDL used to define testing groups; classification comparisons used Matlab SVM (RBF) and LASSO logistic regression. The normative/pathological modeling itself appears to be custom code (no specific package reported).
software_tool.supporting_text: … processed using AssemblyNet … We used the ClinicaDL software … First, we used the nonlinear SVM with RBF kernel of Matlab … Second, we used the logistic regression with LASSO regularization of Matlab …

response_variable.reason: Z-scores of volumes normalized by ICV (% ICV) for multiple structures; primary structures used in HAVAs are hippocampus, amygdala, and inferior lateral ventricle; also tissues, regional tissues, lobes.
response_variable.supporting_text: … z-score normalization of all the normalized volumes (in percentage of ICV) … selected 33 areas … we decided to combine the volume of hippocampus, amygdala, and inferior lateral ventricle … HAVAs is also expressed as a z-score of normalized volume.

predictor_variables.reason: Age is the predictor for lifespan trajectories; CN and AD are modeled separately (group-specific models). ICV used for normalization, not as a predictor.
predictor_variables.supporting_text: Lifespan trajectories of structure volumes across the entire lifespan … models per group (CN vs AD).

predictor_effects.reason: Age modeled with fixed polynomial effects; no random effects or site terms described.
predictor_effects.supporting_text: … considered several low order polynomial models … no mention of random/site effects.

nm_vldtn_handle_ns.reason: Accounts for age nonlinearity via polynomial lifespan models and scale via ICV and z-score normalization; QC addresses image quality. No explicit handling of site/scanner batch effects or heteroscedasticity reported.
nm_vldtn_handle_ns.supporting_text: Sections describing volume normalization (% ICV) with z-scores and QC; no site-effect modeling mentioned.

nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.reason: Reports performance on training ADNI CN vs AD to screen discriminant structures (Table 3), which is non-independent with model development.
nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.supporting_text: TABLE 3 Performance … training ADNI dataset (404 CN vs. 332 AD) … used for screening the most discriminant structures.

nm_vldtn_same_domain_indep.reason: Uses ADNI sMCI vs pMCI (not used for CN/AD training) to test prognosis within the same broader domain (ADNI) with AUC = 78%.

nm_vldtn_diff_domain.reason: External validation on AIBL and MIRIAD shows strong performance (AUC 94% and 96% for AD vs CN).
nm_vldtn_diff_domain.supporting_text: AIBL (467 CN/82 AD) … HAVAs AUC 94%; MIRIAD (23 CN/46 AD) … HAVAs AUC 96%.

clinical_dataset.reason: Clinical application/validation datasets: AIBL, MIRIAD (diagnosis AD vs CN) and ADNI sMCI/pMCI (prognosis).
clinical_dataset.supporting_text: TABLE 2 External dataset used for validation (N = 1,039): AIBL (CN, AD); MIRIAD (CN, AD); ADNI (sMCI, pMCI).

diseases_studied.reason: Alzheimer's disease (AD); Mild cognitive impairment (MCI: sMCI and pMCI).
diseases_studied.supporting_text: … Alzheimer disease (AD) detection and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) prognostic …

clinical_groups_n.reason: AIBL: CN 467, AD 82; MIRIAD: CN 23, AD 46; ADNI: sMCI 255, pMCI 235.
clinical_groups_n.supporting_text: TABLE 2 External dataset used for validation (N = 1,039).

clinical_groups_age.supporting_text: TABLE 2 provides group-wise ages with ranges.

clinical_groups_sex.supporting_text: TABLE 2 lists gender per clinical group.

deviation_metric.reason: Deviation quantified via HAVAs (probability-like score derived from distances to CN/AD lifespan models). For normative baseline, a z-score threshold of 2σ was used to flag abnormality.
deviation_metric.supporting_text: … we proposed new scores … based on the distance to the models … Consequently, the proposed HAVAs … reflects the probability … First, as usually done in normative modeling … we used 2σ as threshold to detect abnormal values …

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Diagnostic and prognostic classification evaluated via BACC, SPE, SEN, and AUC; HAVAs compared against single-structure normative models, deep learning baselines (ClinicaDL), and classical ML (SVM RBF, LASSO logistic regression).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: HAVAs outperforms single-structure normative models and achieves strong external diagnostic performance (AUC 94–96%) and reasonable prognostic performance for pMCI vs sMCI (AUC 78%).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: External diagnosis: AIBL (CN/AD) HAVAs BACC 88%, SPE 93%, SEN 83%, AUC 94%; MIRIAD (CN/AD) HAVAs BACC 89%, SPE 87%, SEN 91%, AUC 96%. Prognosis on ADNI (sMCI vs pMCI): HAVAs BACC 73%, SPE 72%, SEN 74%, AUC 78%.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: No explicit modeling of site/scanner effects; training structure screening includes performance on non-independent ADNI training data (risk of optimistic bias). Overall CN age mean/SD not reported.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: HAVAs is simple and interpretable (sum of hippocampus and amygdala volumes minus inferior lateral ventricle volume, all z-scored by %ICV).

general_notes.general_notes: Training datasets (CN/AD): C-MIND; NDAR; ABIDE; ICBM; IXI; OASIS; ADNI. External validation: AIBL; MIRIAD; ADNI (sMCI/pMCI). CN age range ~0.74–94 years. QC pipeline combines automatic RegQCNet with expert visual review. Normative baseline flagged abnormality at z>|2|; main method uses HAVAs score based on CN/AD lifespan trajectory distances.
